question: What would Minerva-tan do if she found someone who was about to starve to death? Would punching them only cure the malnutrition? Or would she say “Eat the flesh of my arm” and turn into a gory Anpanman? (Note: Anpanman is a children’s cartoon character. His head is bean jam bun for a head that he lets hungry people eat.)
answer: Minerva-tan would probably immediately turn away from someone she couldn’t help. She doesn’t have time to waste, after all.
